param_merge_rule: {**DEFAULT, **S9, **profile_overrides} — Backtest.__init__ 内部亦如此合并, 手工传参必须同规则

selection_hint.K5: 实盘首选: 稳健(W1 sharpe 1.749/DD -10.2%/换手 25×), 目标波动 15%
selection_hint.K3: 激进: W1 收益最高(+2466%)/但换手 154×、DD -28%, 成本敏感(W2 20bp sharpe 0.25)
selection_hint.B0: 基线 S9 (top3, 无目标波动, thr 0.25)

decision_pipeline.name: gate
decision_pipeline.formula: cond_idx = bench[t] > rolling_mean(bench, regime_ma=60)[t] (GT); cond_bw = rolling_mean(breadth, regime_win=5)[t] >= regime_thr (GE, 引擎 b>=thr); mode or→(idx or bw); and→both; breadth→bw; index→idx; none→恒开; 结果 fillna(False)
decision_pipeline.breadth_formula: breadth[t] = count(isfinite(close)&trend_ok&age_ok) / max(count(isfinite(close)&age_ok),1); trend_ok = close>MA20 and MA20>MA60

decision_pipeline.name: close_filters(per held, 顺序即优先级)
order: 止损(stop_loss>0, stop_mode=close: close[t]/entry_px-1 <= -stop_loss; low模式: low/entry-1)
放量离场(use_vol_filter & vol_spike: amount[t-1] > vol_spike_mult × mean(amount[t-vol_win-1:t-1]))
min_hold(t-entry_t < min_hold → 保留, 不卖)
其余保留; 被新候选替换者 reason=排名掉队(use_rank_exit)

decision_pipeline.name: rank_adds
decision_pipeline.rule: rank=_rank(t) 按 score 降序; 新候选需 score >= min(keep_scores)×(1+switch_margin); 跳过 t-last_exit<=cooldown; 补足到 top_n
decision_pipeline.universe_rule: ok = tradable(amt>=min_amt=300万 & valid & close>0) & age_ok(>=min_age=120d) & equity_ok(非货币类) & finite score; pool = static_idx(150只@2019-12-31, amt>=static_min_amt) ∪ dyn_ok(amt5日均>=dyn_min_amt, dyn_win=5); dedupe_theme 每主题留rank最高

decision_pipeline.name: gate_off_override
decision_pipeline.rule: if not regime[t]: target = _defensive(t) = risk_idx(bond_gold: [511260,518880], risk_adaptive=False)

decision_pipeline.name: membership_check
decision_pipeline.rule: 仅当 set(target) != set(held) 才执行交易; rebalance_buffer(0.02) 只在 _execute 内过滤成员已变时的权重漂移单

decision_pipeline.name: weights
decision_pipeline.rule: equal→1/n; score→clip(mom,-5,5)? 否: w∝max(score,1e-3) 归一; 再 × vol_scaler=clip(target_vol/vol20,0,1) (target_vol=0→1); dd_brake=0 不缩放

decision_pipeline.name: execute
decision_pipeline.rule: T+1 开盘 exec_mode=next_open; 单边成本 cost_per_side=1e-4; 跳过非有限/<=0 价; 卖先买后; 现金按 cash_ret(货币ETF) 每日计息

formulas.score: score = clip(mom, -1, score_cap=20) * clip(r2, 0, 1)**r2_power  [engine L288]; mom = exp(clip(slope*252, -5, 5)) - 1  [L164]; r2 = clip(slope^2*A2/sst, 0, 1); cnt < 0.999*lookback → NaN (score 按 max(NaN→1e-3) 兜底, 见 weight=score)
formulas.wls_momentum: log(close) 上 L=mom_lookback(40, S9覆盖; DEFAULT 25) 窗加权线性回归: w_j = exp(mom_decay*(j-(L-1))) 归一 (等价 exp(decay·j) 归一), x=中点居中; 有效点数 cnt < 0.999·L → NaN

universe.equity_exclude_regex: 货币|添益|日利|现金|保证金|理财  (source-behavior: 字面'现金'会误伤'现金流ETF' — 保留原样)
universe.theme_key: name → r'ETF.*$|etf.*$|联接.*$' 去 → 厂商词表(_CO, 40+家) 去 → 括号内容去 → strip; dedupe 每 key 留 rank 首位
universe.dynamic_pool: 5日均成交额(元) >= dyn_min_amt (K5: 5e7, K3: 0 → 全市场)
